official_definition: Great Unsheathe (When Summoned) You can summon 2 Brave cards in the family "Exalted Sword" that can Brave Fuse with this Ultimate from your hand, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Great Unsheathe] or [Great Unsheathe: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Great Unsheathe]", "give [Great Unsheathe]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
